name: capacitor-app-upgrade-v8-to-v9
description: Upgrades a Capacitor app from v8 to v9 (prerelease, installed with @next until GA). Covers preflight (Node 24, Xcode 27, Android Studio 2026.1.1, UIScene adoption from 8.5), `npx cap migrate`, and the manual checklist - iOS 16 target, @UIApplicationMain to @main, removed CAPBridge APIs, AGP 9.2.1, Gradle 9.5.1, SDK 37/minSdk 26, gradle.properties cleanup, built-in Kotlin, jcenter removal, core-ktx, proguard-android.txt rename, optional Cordova runtime, `cap run --url`, push `alert` removal, spla
author: Cap-go
